header.title: CRM
header.description: Stored customer state — one row per customer per snapshot, shared by the Marketing and Churn agents.

noProject.title: No project selected
noProject.body: Pick a project from the sidebar to see its customer book.

empty.title: No customer state yet
empty.body: Build the first snapshot to turn this project's transactions into a customer book.

errors.portfolioFailed: Could not load the customer portfolio.

refresh.scoreChurnOn: Fits a churn model as part of the refresh — slower, but every customer gets a risk tier and a value at risk.
refresh.scoreChurnOff: Observed and derived layers only — RFM, lifecycle and spend. Fast, but no risk scores.

distribution.noRisk: No risk scores in this snapshot.
distribution.stageSub: Derived — a printable rule over observed behaviour
distribution.noStage: No lifecycle stages in this snapshot.
distribution.segmentSub: Derived — the same quintiles the Marketing agent uses
distribution.noSegment: No RFM segments in this snapshot.

coverage.title: Provenance
coverage.subtitle: Every number in the customer book is observed, derived, or predicted — and the page says which.
coverage.predictedRiskNote: Churn model output. Missing when the model could not fit.
coverage.predictedClvNote: Expected future value over the chosen horizon.

table.title: Customer book
table.subtitle: {total} customers in this snapshot · click a row for the full profile

comparison.title: Who would you actually call?
comparison.subtitle: The top {n} customers ranked by churn risk alone, against the top {n} ranked by value at risk — both read from the same stored snapshot, so the two lists provably describe the same customers at the same moment.
comparison.explainer: Prioritising by value at risk instead of probability alone changes {missed} of the names on the call list. Value at risk is priced on {basis}.

snapshots.title: Snapshot history
snapshots.subtitle: Customer state is versioned by date — which is what makes "was this customer riskier last month?" answerable.

detail.noDrivers: Nothing measurably drives this customer's risk.
detail.notExplained: No explanation computed — churn explains only the highest-risk customers it displays.
detail.timelineSingle: Only one snapshot so far. Build another to see this customer's trajectory.
